integrity: The continuum theorem is supported by an explicit first-event recurrence, exact integration and strict convexity. Supplementary rational diagnostics and pathwise simulations cannot replace the analytical proof. This document reports no empirical validation or external audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact binary operating indicators within each labeled cycle; different cycles are independent.
Correlation is held fixed as the second scheduled time shifts; physical weather correlations may change with the time separation.
Time-uniform independent passenger arrivals; first available bus, unlimited capacity and no variable lateness.
The endpoints may place nominal departures at the same physical time and may not be achievable in a real timetable.
Historical originality beyond the inspected literature and independent scientific verification are unresolved.
title: Correlation-driven optimal phase of two unreliable periodic transit departures
